correctness.rationale: The repaired claim classifies five-word binary length-four 2-frameproof codes. After a translation to include zero, the other supports must be a pairwise-intersecting antichain: containment frames the smaller support via zero, and disjointness frames zero. Singletons and the full set cannot coexist with another support. Four supports are possible as exactly four triples or as a three-edge star and its opposite triple; zero, one, two or three two-sets and the triangle case exhaust the options. The representative is frameproof by the pair types (two units, or a unit and all-ones), and its translates by its five words realize the five pointed forms. All translates are distinct by XOR indexing; pair distances follow by the same pair types. Independently evaluated all 4368 five-sets and 8008 six-sets using strict Hamming triangle inequalities on their triples. Found 16 valid five-sets, no six-set, the five pointed forms, all distance profiles (2×6,3×4), and the unique code after translating by total XOR. No larger code is possible by heredity. Coordinate permutations fix the representative, giving the stated order-24 stabilizer. Frozen verifier inspected, not executed; the repaired verification notes state its actual size cutoff.
residual_risks: The finite check and proof concern 2-frameproofness, not 2-IPP or separability. No general length classification follows.

value.rationale: For a natural finite extremal problem, an equality classification determines all optimal objects rather than reproducing their cardinality. It explains the rigidity at length four: one orbit even without permitting coordinate permutations, with an intrinsic XOR index and explicit pointed forms. This gives exact reference data for both separating codes and small hypercube general-position sets.
residual_risks: The motivation is the exact coalition-size-two equality case at length four, not an extrapolation to other lengths or a claim that the known extremal size is new.
